sentences.text: The type specimen, which is the specific fossil the species is based on, consists only of a fragmentary rostrum and teeth.

A complete teleosaurid skull was once assigned to Peipehsuchus, but it was later determined that the skull does not belong to the genus because the type specimen, a fragmentary rostrum and teeth, is a metriorhynchoid.
Fossils of the type species P. teleorhinus have been found in China and fragmentary remains in the Callovian of Kyrgyzstan.
